customManagers.description: ARG versions in images/*/Dockerfile annotated with a # renovate: comment, and the asset SHA256 ARG right after one

packageRules.description: Default off (XERK-2616). Renovate first ran on xerktech/fenrir for AnyPS5; every other dependency (Go modules, actions, base images, Heroic, Nexus) stays hand-bumped as before, so turning it on did not also open a PR per dependency. Rules after this one must set enabled: true: packageRules merge cumulatively.
cmd/nri-input/containerd226 pins the NRI talos04's containerd vendors; bump it with the node's containerd, by hand
Xodus Nexus v0.4.1 quits game shortcut launches (domsvoboda/xodus-nexus#457); images hold v0.4.0 via /opt/xodus-nexus.hold. Drop this rule with the hold.

AnyPS5 (images/anyps5, XERK-2616): each upstream release bumps the relinker and libraries together (their two ARG pairs), and the PR merges itself once CI is green; builder.yml then publishes anyps5:<version> and ArgoCD's Renovate deploys it. The operator chose full automation over a reviewed deploy step (2026-11-01). The main ruleset requires a PR but no approval, and repo auto-merge is off, so Renovate merges a green PR itself on its next hourly run.
